message: The README references scripts/setup-entire.sh but it does not exist. Write it: install the Entire CLI if missing, put the entire-agent-devin plugin on PATH, and enable Entire with the devin agent.

Wrote scripts/setup-entire.sh. It installs the Entire CLI only when missing, symlinks bin/entire-agent-devin and bin/entire-devin-bridge into ~/.local/bin (Entire resolves external agents as entire-agent-<name> on $PATH), then runs 'entire enable -y --agent devin', which also switches on external agent discovery for the rest of Entire.
summary: Add scripts/setup-entire.sh so a clone can register Devin as an Entire agent in one command.
